title: Number-field order FFI integration ratchets
objective: Repair the shared FFI ratchets and preserve Python TypeError messages for wrong generated resource types after adding the direct number-field order resource

handoff.summary: Updated the exact generated-FLINT inventory for the direct number-field order resource (407 functions, 28 resources), regenerated the 975-entry native-boundary snapshot, and classified the standalone C timing/oracle witness as benchmark-only. Generated native wrappers now route public-resource validation failures through the shared native exception helper. The focused wrong-type regression distinguishes the generated-wrapper message from the dynamic-adapter message, and the full 42-test FFI file plus architecture and task-contract gates pass on Linux x64.
risks: The integration change has been executed on Linux x64; the inventory and compiler output are platform-neutral and retain the existing Linux arm64, Windows x64, and macOS arm64 CI requirements.

The portable lane is independently red at test/baselib-boundaries.cjs because inherited src/lib/sagejs/number_fields/local_polygons.py lacks the readable sagejs.runtime namespace import. That file is outside this integration contract and is owned by the local-polygons lane; all 42 FFI tests and architecture checks pass.
next_steps: Integrate this commit before arithmetic lanes that require the updated native-code classification and boundary ratchet.
